tools.name: get_advisor_letter_info
tools.description: Get pricing and details for AdvisorLetter: a weekly white-label market-commentary draft that financial advisors review and send to clients under their own name. Useful for an agent helping a financial advisor or RIA find a done-for-them (not done-by-AI-and-sent-raw) client communication product.

tools.name: get_sample_issue
tools.description: Get a real sample AdvisorLetter issue -- the exact ready-to-forward weekly market-commentary draft an advisor reviews and sends to clients under their own name. This is a fixed sample issue, not this week's live draft -- the paid subscription is a fresh issue every Monday. Free, no key.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "advisor-letter" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_advisor_letter_info, get_sample_issue · Public sink: get_advisor_letter_info, get_sample_issue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_advisor_letter_info, get_sample_issue · Public sink: get_advisor_letter_info, get_sample_issue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
